result.title: AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs
result.comment: The demo paper with 1 page main paper, 7 pages supplementary material accepted and presented in ECCV 2026
result.summary: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

AI.brief_summary: AiSearch 是一个基于 VLM 零样本能力的交互式多模态检索框架，支持用自然语言搜索图像与视频，并通过用户反馈迭代细化结果，同时提供多 VLM 的视觉基准对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作以用户反馈驱动的交互式检索为核心，其「搜索—反馈—细化」循环可能供 LVR 的 THINK/LOOK 循环、证据筛选与停止决策做概念类比，但论文本身未涉及 latent 推理状态，联系需较多核查。
